Poten Tanker Opinion: Santa Came Early This Year
**Author**: Erik Broekhuizen
**Published Date**: 2015-01-01
**Source URL**: [https://www.poten.com/santa-came-early-this-year/](https://www.poten.com/santa-came-early-this-year/)
**Full PDF Report**: [Weekly-Opinion-December-31-2015-Santa-Came-Early-This-Year.pdf](https://potenprd.wpenginepowered.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/12/Weekly-Opinion-December-31-2015-Santa-Came-Early-This-Year.pdf)
**Coverage**: Full PDF archived locally under reports/poten/pdfs/2015/Weekly-Opinion-December-31-2015-Santa-Came-Early-This-Year.pdf. Analysis & Overview
Santa Came Early This Year
31 Dec 2015: As 2015 draws to a close and the Worldscale Organisation published the new 2016 Flat Rates, we go through the annual exercise of updating Flat Rates in our systems. This highlighted once again the significant changes in bunker prices that occurred over the last 2 years.
